hero.badge: Single Origin · Dusun Gura, Buntu Mondong — Enrekang (Latimojong Slopes)
hero.description: High-altitude Arabica from Dusun Gura on the slopes of Mount Latimojong (1,300–1,600m ASL). Slow cherry maturation yields dense Strictly Hard Beans (SHB) with natural sweetness, warm spice, and stomach-friendly low-to-medium acidity.

story.headline: Kalosi coffee heritage since the 1750s from the land of Gura, Buntu Mondong.
story.p1: The name COGURA is rooted directly in Dusun Gura, Buntu Mondong Village, Buntu Batu District — the coffee heartland on the slopes of Mount Latimojong carrying forward the Kalosi Arabica heritage since the 1750s. At 1,300–1,600m ASL with a cool 17°C–19°C microclimate and iron-rich ancient volcanic soil (podzolic Lixisols), coffee trees are shade-grown under the local Sistem Pekon agroforestry wisdom with minimal synthetic chemicals.
story.p2: Buntu Mondong farmers practice a signature Roof-Drying tradition: coffee parchment is dried on dedicated upper roofs built atop farmers' homes rather than on bare ground. This keeps beans free from soil-borne mold contamination (clean cup), maximizes mountain wind circulation, and allows rapid cover when sudden highland rain arrives.

brewingGuide.headline: How to Brew the Perfect COGURA Cup.
brewingGuide.subtitle: Recommended ratios and water temperatures to unlock the floral, ripe berry, and smooth body notes of Enrekang Arabica.

methods.name: Indonesian Tubruk
steps: Add 12g of COGURA ground coffee into a pre-warmed mug.
Pour 180 ml of hot water (let boiling water rest for 1 minute to reach ~93°C).
Stir gently 3–4 times, let it steep for 4 minutes until grounds settle, and enjoy.

methods.name: V60 / Pour Over
steps: Rinse the paper filter with hot water, then add 15g of COGURA coffee.
Bloom: pour 30–40 ml of hot water in circles and wait for 30 seconds.
Continue pouring in stages up to 225 ml, finishing around 2 minutes 30 seconds.

methods.name: French Press / Drip
steps: Add 18g of coffee into your French Press or Vietnamese Drip brewer.
Pour 270 ml of 92°C hot water and gently stir the crust.
Steep for 4 minutes, press the plunger slowly, and serve immediately.

whyChooseUs.headline: Legally protected origin, high-altitude density, roof-dried tradition.
whyChooseUs.f1Desc: Officially registered with Indonesia's DJKI Kemenkumham as Kalosi Enrekang Arabica — guaranteeing 100% authentic Dusun Gura single-origin beans without adulteration.
whyChooseUs.f2Desc: Grown on the 17°C–19°C slopes of Mount Latimojong in iron-rich volcanic Lixisols soil, producing dense Strictly Hard Bean (SHB) cherries.
whyChooseUs.f3Desc: Cultivated ecologically under Sistem Pekon shade trees and dried on elevated rooftop decks above farmers' homes for a clean, mold-free cup.
